title: Ground specialist context packs on WARD_MVP_AGENT_SPEC.md, or record why not
description: Found by the WCLI-8 independent review (2026-09-29). The review profiles lore context pack, compiled by `lore agent context review --task ...`, covers docs/adr/0001-0008 and the index, but WARD_MVP_AGENT_SPEC.md — the v0.1 implementation brief and the spec of record for gates T01-T26 — is not a bundle concept at all, so no pack can cite it. WCLI-8s review therefore grounded its spec claims (section 6.2, 8, 14) on the dispatchers brief rather than on a pack source id, which is exactly the kind of grounding WCLI-24/WCLI-25 built the profiles to supply. Decide whether the spec, or a bounded part of it, should be a bundle concept and a profile source, and implement or record the decision. ADR 0008s machinery (WCLI-25) already forces any new bundle concept into at least one profile and fails on a truncated pack, and the four profile budgets are measured there, so a wide addition has a measured cost to re-run.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Measured and recorded: what a review pack carries today for the WCLI-8-shaped review task, and which spec facts the reviewer had to take from the dispatch brief instead of a pack source, with the pack budget numbers from ADR 0008 re-read rather than remembered

A decision is recorded (spec as a bundle concept and profile source, a bounded extract or reference concept, or an explicit exclusion with its reason), and if the first or second is chosen, demonstrated: the review profile compiles the spec material into its pack within the re-measured budget, scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs exits 0, and lore check --strict exits 0
